title: Bullet
question: Is the value good, fair or poor, and how far from the target?
readings: the dark bar's length: the value
the background ranges: poor, fair, good, cut at the thresholds written under the axis
the word under it: the range the value falls in
strengths: three readings in one line, without a legend (Few's bullet graph)
compares to a target and to thresholds at once, where a gauge needs twice the room
avoid: when time matters more than the level: use goal (pace over a period) or metric (curve)
without thresholds: a plain metric says as much

higherIs.description: Whether the good range is at the top (margin) or at the bottom (delays)

action: mode list: open what pulls the value down (the low-margin orders)
